generic_lessons: Large full current source can consume 60k input tokens while still producing a length-truncated patch or a filename instead of requested test body. Preserve these as failures, do not reconstruct half candidates or equate strict JSON with meaningful implementation.

A real production test should drive the original city writer with native legal modes, budget, placement, active queue and final requalification changes. Helper score assertions alone do not verify integration.

A source version bump has offline diagnostic consumers too. Add only the newly qualified exact version, keep future versions rejected, and preserve static suppression anchors instead of bypassing benchmark failures.

A semantically correct three-line candidate can still have corrupt unified diff hunks. Check raw patch, record rejection, rebuild only independently reviewed exact replacement lines and re-check before applying.

Separate successful tests from a later owner artifact-check bug. An archive prefix mismatch after a green suite is fixed by a correct standalone byte check, not by replaying the entire successful suite or hiding the failed helper.
